description.narrative: The CEECCNA Collaborative Fund (CCF) is an intersectional participatory grantmaking mechanism to support social-justice movements and community-led organizing of feminist and gender justice, ethnic and racial justice, migrant, refugee and forcibly displaced people rights, rights of people living in rural areas, harm reduction and HIV+ movements, sex workers rights, disability rights and justice, climate justice, economic justice, labor and workers rights, land rights, peacebuilding and demilitarization, decolonization, digital rights, narrative change and independent media organizers in Central and Eastern Europe, Caucasus, Central and North Asia (CEECCNA) regions. The Fund's mission is to raise, leverage, and move more resources to grassroots organizers, and historically and presently excluded communities in crises. Their vision is adequately resourced, well-prepared, and thriving social justice movements in the regions.
